# x402 Duration Parser

> Deterministic duration parse / humanize microservice for autonomous agents.
> Pays via x402 (USDC on Base). No accounts, no API keys.

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog — free discovery
- POST /api/parse — parse or humanize (payment required)

## Pricing

~0.0065 USDC per call (exact scheme, Base network)

## Usage for agents

1. GET /catalog to inspect
2. POST /api/parse with body { "action": "parse", "duration": "2h 30m" }
   or { "action": "humanize", "seconds": 9000 }
3. On 402, pay and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header

Supports units: ms, s, m, h, d, w (and long forms).
Built for the Grokzilla / Dragonscale agent economy. No human in the loop.
